title: Button
description: The action control, 1.0 variants: subtle (default) for ordinary actions, surface for toolbar actions, inverse for the main action of a card or a list title row, outline beside an inverse one, ghost for icon buttons, primary / secondary (the brand fills) only for the one main button of a page, a dialog or the nav, danger (solid red) for destructive actions, danger-subtle (the danger tint) for a destructive action that is not the main one. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it.

title: Button group
description: Joins related buttons into one segmented control: shared borders, outer corners only (‹ Hôm nay ›, Lưu | ▾).

title: Card actions
description: Quick actions on a card or media tile: round icon buttons in the top right corner that show on hover or keyboard focus where the device can hover, and one always-visible ⋯ with every action on touch screens. Goes inside a `group relative` card.

title: Chip
description: A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags, without a border. Off: the subtle button fill; on: the raised surface (or its tone's tint) with a leading check, so the state does not rest on colour alone. 34px, 44px on a touch phone.

title: External link
description: A link to another site: opens a new tab on desktop and the external browser inside a mobile WebView, with an external-link icon.

title: Split button
description: The main action and a ▾ that opens a Menu of the other ways to do the same job (Thêm khách hàng | ▾ Nhập từ file, Tìm trong Data Hub). One filled button in total; below sm one button opens the whole list, the main action first.

title: Toggle
description: Buttons that stay pressed. Toggle for one (pin, mute, bold); ToggleGroup for a set of icon or short options, one or several at a time (list / grid view, text styles).

title: Calendar
description: A month grid to pick one day or a range (YYYY-MM-DD, weeks start on Monday). DatePicker shows it in a popover; place it inline for schedules and report filters.

title: Checkbox
description: A native checkbox with label and description, checked fill in the accent, and an indeterminate state for “select all”.

title: Combobox
description: CustomCombobox: type to filter a long or grouped list (diacritic-aware, IME-safe), then pick one value or keep a new one.

title: Date picker
description: A date field with a Calendar popover (YYYY-MM-DD, min / max). Never type="date".

title: Field, Input, Textarea
description: Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers; `kind` sets the phone keyboard, autofill and Enter key of an email, phone, number, money, URL, search or password field. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field).

title: FileDrop
description: A file picker and dropzone with one row per file (size, upload progress, done, remove / retry on failure) plus DropZone, its compact dashed-tile variant for workspace panels (optional file rows). Controlled: the app owns the list and does the upload.

title: Filter chip row
description: A list page's filters as one line of chips (icon, label, chevron; solid with the value or count when on). Each chip opens a small multi-select popover, a single-choice chip a radio menu (“Hộp thư: Tất cả”), a switch chip toggles; the page's views (SegmentedControl) can lead the row; the row scrolls sideways with ‹ › when it overflows, shows “Xoá lọc” while a filter is on and ends with `sort`, zero-shift `selection` (“Chọn” via `useListSelection`) and `ViewSwitch`. State in the URL with useFilterParams or the filterParams helpers.

title: Filter panel
description: Filters on phones: one segmented pill (the page's views · Bộ lọc with the count · sort and view settings) that opens a full-screen panel: sort first, booleans as switches, one accordion per filter (a radio group for a single-choice one), “Xem N kết quả” at the bottom. From sm the panel is a side sheet, also the “Bộ lọc” panel of a page with more filters than its chip row shows.

title: Form actions, unsaved guard, validation
description: The same form behaviour everywhere: FormActions (Huỷ then Lưu / Tạo, sticky on a page, the footer of a Modal), useUnsavedGuard (nobody loses typed work), and validation that shows on blur then follows changes, with an Alert summary for several errors.

title: Hint textarea
description: A text area that says what it can do (L15): a hint row under the text (“Gõ @ để nhắc nhà cung cấp · Gõ / để chèn mẫu”) and a suggestion list while the word at the caret starts with a trigger; the chosen item is inserted with a space after it.

title: Input group
description: An input with fixed parts around it: a prefix (https://), a unit (kg, ₫), an icon or a small button (copy, show password).

title: Input OTP
description: One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, SMS autofill, screen readers and the number keypad work like a normal field.

title: Multi combobox
description: Searchable multi-select: chosen values show as removable chips, an add button (default “Thêm” / “Add”) opens a portaled popover with a quiet search field and a checkbox list. Supports option groups (`group`), diacritic-aware search and Vietnamese Telex IME.

title: Number input
description: NumberInput: numbers with a touch keypad (NumPadPopup) on phones and tablets, plain typing elsewhere. Never type="number".

title: Option cards
description: Selectable cards with radio-group semantics (arrow keys, single tab stop): icon, name, optional description, neutral selected state (`bg-item-selected` + `border-outline-line` + `text-strong`, no brand tint) and 8px grid gap.

title: Radio group
description: Exactly one option of a few, each with an optional description; vertical by default.

title: Search input
description: The toolbar search: an icon button that opens into a field (clear button, h-control); it collapses again when empty and focus leaves. SubpageToolbar includes one.

title: Search pill
description: The wide pill search of a list page (one per page), with an optional `trailing` slot for `<BarActions>` when pinned in StickyContextBar. Typing is debounced (250 ms), Escape and the clear button clear at once, an optional key (/) focuses it.

title: Select
description: CustomSelect: pick one value from a list, in a field, in a toolbar, inline in a row or bare. Never the native <select>.

title: Slider
description: Pick a number in a range by dragging: one thumb, or two with range for a min–max pair.

title: Stepper
description: − value + for a small count (quantities, copies, seats) in a workspace panel or a card: one tap per step, a unit after the value, min and max.

title: Switch
description: An on / off toggle for settings that apply immediately.

title: View switch
description: List ↔ grid and an optional density toggle, as small icon toggles at the end of the filter row (FilterChipRow trailing).

title: Command
description: Command palette and searchable action lists: CommandPalette is the app-wide ⌘K / Ctrl+K “search or create” box (mounted once in the root layout, fed by pages with useRegisterCommands); CommandDialog is a controlled dialog with your own open state (useHotkey); Command is the inline list. Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks.

title: Confirm dialog
description: confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false; confirmDelete({ name }) is the irreversible-action form (names the object, red Xoá). Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm.

title: Context menu
description: The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus.

title: Detail overlay
description: An item of a list opens over the list instead of on its own page: its own URL (?open=<id> with useDetailParam, Next App Router safe), ‹ › and ← → through the current results with “n / N”, close / Esc / Back return to the list at the same scroll position. The side panel holds the actions (SplitButton, an icon row, ⋯); existing detail routes stay as deep-link targets.

title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the right, left, bottom or top (a sheet), with title and footer.

title: Feature intro
description: The first visit of a feature (L14): a small dialog with a visual, a title, one line, dots, “Bỏ qua” and “Tiếp” / “Bắt đầu”. Shown once per user per id; “seen” lives in a store (localStorage by default, pass your own to keep it per account). It waits while another dialog is open.

title: Hover card
description: A preview card while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, a link: a person, a product, an order.

title: Menu
description: The action menu behind a trigger: a ⋯ (or your own Button) with items that have an icon, a description line, a shortcut or hint, a check, a spinner, a link, a reason when disabled, and group headings. Danger items always go last after a divider; hidden items (and empty groups) leave the list; below sm it opens as a bottom sheet.

title: Modal
description: The shared dialog: full screen on phones, a centred panel from sm up, with title, description, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener.

title: Popover
description: A small non-modal panel under its trigger for interactive content: a quick form, filters, a picker.

title: Toast
description: One toast API for feedback after an action: toast.success / error / warning / info, toast.undo for a reversible destructive action, toast.promise for work in progress. Irreversible actions ask first (confirmDelete). Mount ToastHost once in the root layout.

title: Tooltip
description: A short label on hover or focus, mostly for icon-only buttons.

title: App header
description: The top bar of a stand-alone tool app: logo + title go home, the module name, and one primary action on the right. No Home button.

title: App shell
description: The 1.0 frame of a multi-page app: a canvas frame with the nav panel (main action, groups, pinned, a bottom row of icon tools) and the content column (the RouteHeader with crumbs, actions and the account avatar menu, then the content card). The nav is the 72px rail first when width runs short (always md–lg, by default lg–1280, the user's toggle remembered), then the phone drawer. Alt + 1…9 opens a nav item. This docs site is an AppShell; the full example runs at /demo/app-shell/.

title: Breadcrumb
description: Where the page sits: a trail of links ending with the current page. Long trails collapse their middle into a “…” menu.

title: List + reader
description: A list card beside a reader card (`ListReaderLayout`) with a sticky one-row `ReaderHeader` (wrapping title left, [•••] then one main action right, top-aligned, identical button height). Each panel scrolls independently on `AppShell page="fixed"` / `Page fixed` with zero hand-tuned `calc()`. Open item lives in `?open=` (`useDetailParam`) and `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs (`useRecordCrumb`); when the layout is too narrow for the list and a 360px reader (its own width, not the viewport), the reader replaces the list with a Back button.

title: Mega menu
description: A flyout of links in category columns: a text-overline header per column, links with a grey icon, a hint and a New badge, and a See all link. AppShell opens it beside the sidebar from a nav item with mega; an app can open it from its own trigger.

title: Menubar
description: The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): menus that open from a bar and behave like Menu.

title: Minimal header
description: The top row of a detail or settings page inside AppShell: where the page sits on the left (a Breadcrumb), one text link and one primary action on the right. The page's own heading follows it.

title: Navigation menu
description: Top navigation of a website or landing page: links, and items that open a panel of links with descriptions. Below md it becomes one menu button with a sheet.

title: Page actions
description: Lets a page put its actions into a slot of the shared header: PageActionsProvider wraps the layout, PageActionsSlot marks where they render, PageActions sends them from the page.

title: Page layouts
description: Shared 1.0 page anatomy and three layouts inside AppShell's content card: work (flush, padding 16 / 24), reading (centred max 1536px inside 16px card padding, 64px bottom), and two-column (240px sub-nav card + 4px gap + main card, stacking below md). Owns vertical rhythm (32 / 28 / 32 / 16 / 8).

title: Page title
description: PageTitle is the 18 / 400 UI sans heading of a work page on the same row as the page's main action (`actions`), with `variant="reading"` (44 / 500 display face, text-title-xl) for one-column reading pages only.

title: Pagination
description: Page numbers with previous / next for long tables. For card lists prefer auto-loading with “Xem thêm”.

title: Pill tabs
description: Default section tabs for pages with 5+ sections or sections with icons (settings-like pages): no track, h30 round pills with 16px icons and 12px/600 labels, and one item-hover pill that slides to the active tab in 300ms ease-out.

title: Resizable panels
description: Panels side by side or stacked with handles to resize them (an editor beside a preview, a list beside details). Sizes are percentages and can be remembered.

title: Route header banner
description: One announcement in the route header's centre slot: a “Mới” tag, one line of text, an optional date, a pill CTA and a close button. Closed once per user per id (localStorage by default, or your own store). Below md the header's centre is hidden and the same banner is one row at the top of the page content.

title: Scroll area
description: A fixed-size scrolling region (a long list in a card, a log). Semi hides scrollbars, so it marks the edges that have more content, can show a thin scrollbar, and is reachable by keyboard.

title: Segmented control
description: Small single-choice filter sets shown in full (2–5 values, often with tabular-nums counts): a `raised` track (h32, radius 8, padding 4, gap 4) with h24 items (12px/600) and one solid `raised-2` pill (white in light theme) sliding in 300ms ease-out.

title: Side panel
description: A 320px tool panel beside a canvas that collapses to a 48px rail; SidePanelToggle is its collapse button.

title: Sticky context bar
description: The top of a list page that pins on scroll or search focus (250ms ease-out), holds against trackpad momentum and flings, and moves up to 2 page actions into SearchPill via BarActions while pinned. Pins by layout from md+ with independent overscroll-contained list/reader scrollers; keeps native touch scrolling below md.

title: Subpage toolbar
description: The sticky row with a page's filters on the left and search, refresh and the icon-only primary action on the right: under the page title, or with the title on the same row (title). RefreshButton spins while its promise runs.

title: Tabs
description: Switch between panels of content inside a card or dialog with underline tabs, icons and counts.

title: Text tabs
description: Big display tabs (`font-display text-tab-xl`, 24px below sm / 28px from sm, weight 400) for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page: every tab in strong text colour, inactive at opacity 0.2 (raised on hover in 150ms), active with a 2px brand underline at 6px offset under the word only.

title: Workspace layout
description: Page type “workspace” (L12): a control panel on the left (segmented tabs, back + tool name, sections with a text-overline label and a counter like “3/8”, drop zones, steppers, a message box) with the main action pinned at its bottom, and the result on the right. Phones stack the panel above the result with the action at the bottom of the screen.

title: Accordion
description: A list of sections where one (or several) open at a time: FAQs, settings groups, help.

title: Aspect ratio
description: Keeps media at a fixed ratio while its width follows the layout (images, video, maps, 3D previews).

title: Avatar & LetterAvatar
description: A person or team: their image, two initials on a stable tone (`Avatar`), or one upper-cased letter (`vi` locale, "?" when empty) on a neutral fill (`LetterAvatar`, or `Avatar initials={1}`).

title: Badge
description: A read-only status or tag in a tone (10% fill, no border, theme-safe text; one fixed palette for every brand), tone="overlay" for text on an image or video, and the attention marks in the brand colour: CountBadge (unread, to approve; 99+ cap) and NewTag ("Mới").

title: Card
description: The bento content card: the card surface (bg-card, separated from the page by tone: no border, no shadow, rounded-card). bordered frames a dense data view; interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item.

title: Carousel
description: Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrow keys, buttons or dots (CSS scroll-snap, no library). Phones show one slide and a peek of the next.

title: Chart
description: Charts in SVG on Semi tokens, no library: BarChart (grouped or stacked columns), LineChart (optional area wash), DonutChart (parts of a whole) and Sparkline (a trend in a tile). Series use the fixed chart-1…8 colours (validated for colour-blind readers in both themes); every chart has a legend for 2+ series, a hover / keyboard tooltip and a table view.

title: Code block
description: Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button and an optional title (file name); long lines scroll sideways. Plain text, no highlighting.

title: Collapsible
description: One section that opens and closes under its trigger row (advanced options, details of a log line).

title: Data table
description: A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it).

title: Icon
description: The semantic icon registry (stroke 1.75, 24px grid). IconTile is the rounded tinted square that leads cards and dialogs.

title: Item
description: A list row — leading icon / avatar / image, title and description, meta on the right, actions — and ItemGroup, which stacks rows in a card with dividers.

title: Kbd
description: A key or a shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) as key caps, for menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text.

title: KPI card
description: A metric card: label, a large tabular figure in the style's figure font, a sub line coloured good / danger. One featured card leads the row; icons are optional and neutral.

title: Markdown
description: Renders AI or user text safely: paragraphs, lists, bold, inline code and links (as ExternalLink). No HTML.

title: QR code
description: A scannable QR code as one SVG: VietQR / EMVCo payment payloads, receipts (print variant), links. Fixed black modules on white with a 4-module quiet zone in both themes, four error-correction levels, optional caption and copy button.

title: Separator
description: A thin divider between groups of content: horizontal, vertical, or with a short label in the middle (“hoặc”).

title: Table
description: A dense table for rows compared column by column. Cells stay on one line (the table scrolls sideways on phones); TD wrap for a long-text column, numeric for figures.

title: Typography
description: The 1.0 type scale (text-tag 10 … text-hero 36, text-ui 14 for content, text-chrome 12 for the shell chrome, font-display for hero and big titles) and Prose, which styles long-form text — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code — from that scale.

title: Alert
description: A message that stays on the page: info, success, warning, danger, with a title, an action and an optional dismiss.

title: Empty state
description: What an empty list or page shows. `first-use`: one icon, one sentence, the one primary action that fills it. `no-results`: a search or filter matched nothing, with its own title and a “Xoá lọc” action.

title: Error, not found, no access
description: The page-level states every app needs: ErrorState (what failed, with a retry), NotFound (a wrong URL) and Forbidden (no access), each with a link home, plus the route-file recipe (loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx) that uses them.

title: Guided empty state
description: The EmptyState variant “guided” (L13): the first use of a page that needs a few steps before it is useful. A step carousel (“Bước 1 / 4”, a visual, ‹ ›) or numbered steps, the one primary action, a link to the full guide, and rows of ready starting points by category, each with “Xem tất cả”.

title: Progress
description: A determinate bar with value, or an indeterminate one when the end is unknown; tones for success and danger.

title: Skeleton
description: Quietly pulsing placeholders (`motion-pulse`: 2.5s opacity 1 → 0.6 → 1, stops under prefers-reduced-motion) while content loads, shaped like what loads: Skeleton blocks, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, SkeletonList (divided list rows), SkeletonTable (table rows), SkeletonDetail (a record's detail panel), PageSkeleton; Loading announces the region. Never “Đang tải…” text or a spinner in a list. BootLoader is the one centred spinner, for the boot / session gate before the shell exists.

title: Task host
description: startTask() shows one blocking overlay for a job the user must wait for: label, current step, progress, elapsed time and an optional Cancel. Mount TaskHost once in the root layout, next to ToastHost and ConfirmHost.

title: Action confirmation
description: An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send, delete, pay, run a command): what it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; the outcome replaces the buttons once decided.

title: AI chat
description: AIChat is the ready-made assistant panel: ChatPanel (side panel or full screen, resizable, keyboard inset) around ChatView (list + composer). UI only: the app keeps the messages, streams the answer and calls the model.

title: Chat messages
description: The parts of a conversation, to compose your own chat: UserMessage, AssistantMessage (+ ChatAnswer for a ChatItem), ChatThinking, ChatError, ChatCopyButton, ChatAvatar, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion(s), ChatList and ChatComposer.

title: Chat model picker
description: Provider → model → effort chips, for the toolbar of a chat composer. The lists are app data.

title: Context meter
description: How full the model's context window is: a small ring with the percent, token counts in a tooltip; amber from 80%, red from 95%.

title: File tree
description: Files and folders as a keyboard tree, with A / M / D marks for what an agent added, modified or deleted; select a file to open it.

title: Reasoning
description: The model's reasoning above its answer: open while it streams, folded to “Đã suy luận trong N giây” when done, reopenable.

title: Sources
description: Where an answer came from: Citation marks inside the text (numbered, linked) and a Sources list under the answer that opens to the pages.

title: Task list
description: The agent's plan: steps with a status mark (chưa làm, đang làm, xong, lỗi, bỏ qua), an optional line under each, and a progress count.

title: Terminal
description: A command and its output: streams and follows the end (unless people scroll up), shows a spinner while running and the exit code when done, with a copy button.

title: Tool call
description: One tool the agent called: its name in words, a status badge (chờ, đang chạy, xong, lỗi, chờ duyệt), and on open the input and output (JSON formatted).

title: Agent workspace
description: A full agent turn composed from the AI parts: the request, reasoning, a plan, tool calls, an approval, the answer with sources and a composer with the context meter. Copy it with `semi add agent-run`.

title: Dashboard
description: An overview page: title, KPI row with trends, a revenue chart, orders by status and the latest orders. Copy it with `semi add dashboard`, then replace the sample data.

title: List page
description: A 1.0 records page on Page layout="work": 18/400 title row with an inverse action, StickyContextBar with SearchPill + FilterChipRow (sort, Chọn and in-place selection mode on the filter row; PhoneFilterBar on phones; no result-count row), DataTable / Card grid / phone Item rows sharing the same selection model, and DetailOverlay (?open=). Copy it with `semi add list-page`.

title: Settings page
description: A 1.0 settings page on Page layout="reading" (centred max 1536px inside 16px card padding, 64px bottom) with PillTabs section navigation and one save action per section. Copy it with `semi add settings-page`.

title: Locale
description: SemiLocaleProvider sets the UI strings of every Semi component (Vietnamese by default, English shipped, override any string).

title: Theme
description: Light / dark / system: ThemeScript applies the stored theme before paint, ThemeProvider keeps it, ThemeSwitcher (three-way: segmented, or variant="menu" as one icon button) and ThemeToggle switch it, useThemeUtility() puts the three in AppShell's utilities. data-theme on any element re-scopes every token inside it.
